appln_title: Power line inspection robot control method in windy environment
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a power line inspection robot control method in a windy environment. A wind velocity sensor is arranged on an inspection robot. Real-time wind velocity vector is measured, and measured data are fed back to an inspection robot control system. The inspection robot control system uses a built-in algorithm, and the wind velocity measured by the wind velocity sensor is sent back to the control system and is subtracted by current walking velocity vector to acquire the exact value of the wind velocity in the current natural environment. The value is sent back to a ground station through a digital radio and is provided for an operator. According to the invention, the risk possibility of the inspection robot in the windy environment can be effectively reduced, and the safety of the inspection robot is improved.
reason: Il testo descrive un metodo di controllo per un robot di ispezione di linee elettriche in ambiente ventoso, con sensori di velocità del vento e comunicazione con una stazione a terra. Tuttavia, non è chiaro se il robot sia un veicolo aereo senza pilota o un robot terrestre. Non ci sono indicazioni esplicite che si tratti di un drone o di un velivolo senza pilota, quindi non è possibile decidere con certezza la pertinenza al settore.
evidence: Power line inspection robot control method in windy environment; A wind velocity sensor is arranged on an inspection robot; The value is sent back to a ground station through a digital radio

appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a flight device allowing an operator to easily and visually determine its position and a distance to an obstacle.SOLUTION: A flight device 10 comprise: an irradiation part 25 to apply a light 26 from a machine body unit 11 to outside. The irradiation part 25 projects an image onto an obstacle existing around the machine body unit 11 by applying a light 26, The projected image becomes bright and small when the obstacle is close to the machine body unit 11, while the projected image becomes dark and large when the obstacle is far away from the machine body unit 11. An operator controls the machine body unit 11 determines a distance between the machine body unit 11 and the obstacle by watching the image projected from the irradiation part 25. Thus, the operator can easily determines the distance because the way to determine the distance between the machine body unit 11 and the obstacle is intuitive to the operator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
reason: Il testo descrive un dispositivo di volo con un sistema di proiezione luminosa per determinare la distanza da ostacoli, ma non specifica se si tratta di un veicolo aereo senza pilota o di un altro tipo di dispositivo di volo. Non è chiaro se la soluzione è specifica per droni o UAV, quindi la pertinenza al settore non è affidabile.
evidence: A flight device 10 comprise: an irradiation part 25 to apply a light 26 from a machine body unit 11 to outside. The irradiation part 25 projects an image onto an obstacle existing around the machine body unit 11

appln_abstract: One example includes a system control architecture that includes local control systems to provide respective condition signals associated with situational awareness conditions of an associated system architecture. A central system controller receives the condition signals, generates a control scheme for control of operational aspects of the associated system architecture based on the condition signals, and generates control signals based on the control scheme. The control scheme defines contributions of each of the local control systems to a control authority of each of the operational aspects. Operational components provide mechanical control of each of the operational aspects of the associated system architecture in response to the respective control signals to implement the control scheme. A control authority interface system provides an indication to a user of the respective contributions of the control authority of each of the respective local control systems to the operational aspects of the associated system architecture.
reason: Il testo descrive un'architettura di controllo di sistema con sistemi di controllo locali e un controller centrale, ma non specifica se si tratta di un veicolo aereo senza pilota o di una tecnologia specifica per droni o velivoli autonomi. Non è chiaro se l'invenzione riguarda direttamente il settore degli UAV o è una tecnologia generica di controllo applicabile a vari sistemi.
evidence: System control architecture that includes local control systems to provide respective condition signals associated with situational awareness conditions of an associated system architecture.

appln_title: Method and a device for marking the ground for an aircraft in flight, and an aircraft including the device
appln_abstract: A method of marking a landing zone on ground for an aircraft in flight. The aircraft projects on the ground a light shape referred to as a “projected light shape” comprising at least one line of light defining a geometrical surface, the aircraft tending to place at least a portion of landing gear of the aircraft on the geometrical surface, the projected light shape being identical regardless of the position of the projector in air space.
reason: Il testo descrive un metodo e un dispositivo per marcare una zona di atterraggio a terra per un aeromobile in volo, con proiezione di una forma luminosa. Tuttavia, non è specificato se l'aeromobile è senza pilota o autonomo, né se la tecnologia è specifica per UAV o droni. Potrebbe applicarsi anche ad aeromobili con pilota.
evidence: "A method of marking a landing zone on ground for an aircraft in flight" e "the aircraft projects on the ground a light shape"

appln_title: Dynamic aircraft threat controller manager apparatuses, methods and systems
appln_abstract: The DYNAMIC AIRCRAFT THREAT CONTROLLER MANAGER APPARATUSES, METHODS AND SYSTEMS (“DATCM”) transforms flight profile information, terrain, weather/atmospheric data and flight parameter data via DATCM components into comprehensive hazard avoidance optimized flight plans. Comprehensive hazard avoidance includes synergistic comprehensive turbulence and airfoil-specific icing data. In one implementation, the DATCM comprises a processor and a memory disposed in communication with the processor and storing processor-issuable instructions to receive anticipated flight plan parameter data, obtain weather data based on the flight plan parameter data, obtain atmospheric data based on the flight plan parameter data, and determine a plurality of four-dimensional grid points based on the flight plan parameter data. The DATCM may then determine comprehensive hazards mappings. With (near) real-time comprehensive hazard information and/or predictive turbulence/icing forecast specific to airfoil type and/or profile parameters, the DATCM may allow aircraft to avoid areas where comprehensive hazard is greater than a predetermined threshold and/or avoid areas where turbulence/icing may occur.
reason: Il testo descrive un sistema per la gestione di minacce e la pianificazione di voli ottimizzati basati su dati atmosferici e di volo, ma non specifica se è destinato esclusivamente a velivoli senza pilota o droni autonomi. Potrebbe essere applicabile sia a velivoli con pilota che senza, quindi non è chiaro se la soluzione tecnica è specifica per il settore degli UAV.
evidence: Dynamic aircraft threat controller manager apparatuses, methods and systems; trasformazione di dati di volo, terreno, meteo e parametri di volo in piani di volo ottimizzati per evitare pericoli.
